candidate.product_name: 免手动电动尾门（带标志投影）
candidate.product_name_en: Hands-Free Power Liftgate with logo projection
candidate.product_version: 标志投影+可编程开启高度版本；接近车尾约6英尺自动点亮投影标识
candidate.market: 通用汽车品牌SUV/跨界车电动尾门配置；需核查中国在售车型配置表
candidate.reason_for_deep_dive: 摘要明确有地面Logo投影用于指示踢脚位置，并通过保险杠下方踢脚动作开启/关闭尾门，对应C1-F6的投影图像和脚部检测，以及C1-F5的尾门控制；还需下游核查中国市场具体车型、智能钥匙认证和尾门下方传感器/投影器布置。
candidate.initial_evidence_summary: 雪佛兰支持页摘要显示：Hands-Free Power Liftgate with logo projection and programmable height 可通过保险杠下方简单踢脚动作开启/关闭；部分车辆地面会出现发光Logo投影提示踢脚位置；Logo投影在用户进入车尾约6英尺范围内自动点亮。

launch_date: 未明确（证据仅显示现行雪佛兰支持页及2025款车型说明书中存在该功能，未能确定首次上市/发布年月）

launch_date_evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Vehicle Support | Chevy
launch_date_evidence.snippet: Available Hands-Free Power Liftgate with logo projection and programmable height, if equipped, lets you open and close your liftgate with a simple kicking motion below the bumper.

launch_date_evidence.title: 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe owner manual excerpt
launch_date_evidence.snippet: 感应操作：如果配备该功能，携带遥控钥匙从接近区外进入身份验证区可打开尾门；身份验证区1米，接近区3米，均位于车辆后部附近。

disqualification_reason: 未发现该具体“带标志投影的免手动电动尾门”首次上市时间早于专利申请日2014-07-31；现有证据不触发上市日期失格。

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Vehicle Support | Chevy
evidence.snippet: Approach the liftgate with your key fob. The logo projection will automatically turn on as you get within 6 feet... Kick straight over the logo... The liftgate will open.

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Chevrolet Canada
evidence.snippet: Make sure that your key fob is within 0.9 metres of your vehicle... Kick directly toward the underside of your vehicle... the liftgate is opening.

comparisons.patent_feature: 所述信息采集模块设置在车辆后备箱并用于获取用户与车辆后备箱的距离信息
comparisons.competitor_feature: 页面要求在车尾/举升门处携带钥匙接近，进入距车尾约6 ft/1.8 m范围时logo自动点亮；踢脚需朝车辆下方且距保险杠5 in/12.7 cm内，表明车尾区域传感系统获取用户/脚部接近距离。

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Vehicle Support | Chevy
evidence.snippet: The logo projection will automatically turn on as you get within 6 feet of the rear of your vehicle. Kick straight over the logo... within 5 inches of the bumper.

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Chevrolet Canada
evidence.snippet: The logo projection will automatically turn on as you get within 1.8 metres of the rear of your vehicle... within 12.7 centimetres of the bumper.

comparisons.reasoning: 证据给出车尾6英尺和保险杠5英寸阈值，说明有车尾接近/踢脚检测；但未明确该距离信息由“信息采集模块”而非钥匙系统单独采集。

comparisons.patent_feature: 所述智能钥匙模块包括设置在车辆钥匙中的钥匙感应单元，以及设置在车辆后备箱并可探测到所述钥匙感应单元的探测天线
comparisons.competitor_feature: 雪佛兰系统要求用户携带key fob接近举升门；key fob需在车尾附近0.9 m/3 ft内，2025款手册片段称车尾附近有1 m身份验证区和3 m接近区，可识别遥控钥匙。

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Vehicle Support | Chevy
evidence.snippet: Approach the liftgate with your key fob... Make sure that your key fob is within 3 feet of your vehicle.

evidence.title: 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe owner manual excerpt
evidence.snippet: 携带遥控钥匙从接近区外进入身份验证区可打开尾门。这两个区域均位于车辆后部附近。身份验证区（1米），接近区（3米）。

comparisons.reasoning: key fob和车尾身份验证区直接支持智能钥匙探测；但未直接写明“后备箱探测天线”的硬件位置，按无钥匙认证原理推定。

comparisons.competitor_feature: 用户在logo/sensor处完成踢脚动作后，系统延时提示并自动开启/关闭liftgate；还支持可编程开启高度，说明存在电动尾门执行机构和控制判断逻辑。

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Vehicle Support | Chevy
evidence.snippet: Kick straight over the logo... Your kick should be an in-and-out motion... The liftgate will open... You can also use a kicking motion to close the liftgate.

evidence.title: Hands-Free Power Liftgate | Chevrolet Canada
evidence.snippet: The liftgate will open after giving you time to safely step away. The rear lights will flash and a chime will sound to alert you that the liftgate is opening.

evidence.snippet: On some vehicles, an illuminated logo projection will appear on the ground to show you where to kick... Kick straight over the logo (or at the sensor for older vehicles), making sure to come within 5 inches of the bumper.

evidence.snippet: Kick straight over the logo... Sweeping the foot side to side or stepping on the logo projection will not activate the sensor... Kick directly toward the underside of your vehicle.
